notablePrerequisites:
It is your upkeep step.
You control at least three artifacts.
description:
During your upkeep, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kuldotha Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Kuldotha Phoenix dies, Anax triggers, creating two 1/1 Satyr creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Satyr, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kuldotha Phoenix by paying {4}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
